name: e2e-cyber-bench
description: An end-to-end benchmark intended to evaluate models on cybersecurity-related tasks such as vulnerability identification, incident description and remediation suggestions. It measures both classification/detection abilities and generative reasoning in security contexts, using synthetic and/or real-world scenario prompts to test practical cyber workflows. The suite is designed to probe model correctness, completeness, and safety-relevant behavior in security tasks.
reputation: Niche Hugging Face benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers working on security-related LLM evaluation.
